title: A stacked batch whose head moves only by merging its base's fix keeps its go and head lint (EXPRESS)
why: Retro 12:53 CST Nov 13: today batch 138 stacks on red batch 137; a head that moves only by the base's fix should not need a new go or a full CI run.
source: retrospective 12:53 CST Nov 13; owner 12:48 CST to runner 10: "im pretty sure all this is being solved"
note: EXPRESS (R55 merge flow), todo, no lane yet. When a stacked batch's head moves only by merging its base's fix, the merge tool proves the head diff equals that fix and keeps the go and the head lint; CI runs only the jobs that read the fix's files. Basis, read by meaning: decision test-strategy-reset (no duplicate runs) and plan R62. A guard or check change: a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Related, not the same: stacked-base-merge-keeps-record (the review record stays live after a clean merge of the base) and busy-file-stacked-batches. Past rulings checked first.
